items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Edward Blackwell played drums, who went with Arnett Coleman.

ctx.x: Well, it was Deluxe. I tell you. Yeah, because, well that was the company.

Deluxe it was, forty-nine. We'll look it up. Yeah, Mellow Mama, that's the name of it. What was it released as? It was released as Mellow Mama. The Johnson Brothers? The Johnson Brothers. The Johnson Brothers. The Johnson Brothers. That's right, Mellow Mama. I believe it was a, because it took us a year to get the money, and at the time it was forty dollars for a recording session, which was still a lot of money. And forty-nine was plenty of money. And, because I played with that band, and that's the best band I…
Yeah, well I think Sonny was working for Specialty at the same time. Yeah.
